summary: Verified the PayPal Premium (£14.99) button rendering fix on mobile and desktop. Bug is RESOLVED: on mobile 390x844 the £14.99 PayPal button now renders as a zoid-paypal-buttons iframe of 302x45 inside the premium-pack-section. Regression check on the £9.99 member/donate button also passes on mobile (iframe 318x45 inside #support). Desktop 1280x900: premium button renders 444x45. No console/page errors related to PayPal. UI-test mode (client-id=test) as intended.

issues: The deployed build does not expose data-testid="member-access-section" on the <section id="support"> element even though the source file has it. Likely a stale build asset — the section, its inner donation-recovery-email input, and the PayPal iframe do render correctly on both mobile and desktop, so this is cosmetic only (may affect future automation using that testid). The premium-pack-section testid IS present.

action_items: Optional: rebuild/redeploy frontend so the data-testid="member-access-section" attribute (present in source) reaches the browser bundle. Functionality is unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: PayPalPremiumButton.jsx: fix looks correct — usePayPalScriptReducer + PremiumButtonsWithState guards the mount until the SDK script resolves, mirroring the working donate pattern. Consider also handling isRejected (as PayPalDonateButton does) so ad-block failures surface a message on the Premium button too.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend only. PayPal is in UI-test mode via REACT_APP_PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID=test. Verify PayPal renders by checking for div[id^='zoid-paypal-buttons'] and its iframe with non-zero height inside each PayPal button container.
rca of the issue: Original bug: PayPalPremiumButton rendered <PayPalButtons> unconditionally, so on slower mobile networks the SDK wasn't ready at mount and PayPal silently produced no iframe. Fix (verified): PremiumButtonsWithState now consumes usePayPalScriptReducer, shows a loading state while isPending, and mounts <PayPalButtons> in a min-width container. Result: iframe renders reliably on 390x844 (302x45) and on 1280x900 (444x45).
